messages:
sylvie: Heads-up: we're seeing structured-output schema drift hitting ~7% of model v2 responses in EU. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dash/rollouts/3961234567 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Started percent rollout v2 -> 10% traffic (eu-west-1) at 3961234562

devops (jamal): I can pause the rollout. Suggestion: pin routing for eu to v1 and keep global canary at 10% while we investigate.

kai: +1. The failures are mismatched JSON keys causing downstream parsers to throw. Request samples in #incidents linked.

lisa: Repro steps: send sample prompt with function call S3->parseJSON and observe missing "items" key intermittently.

ops-oncall: Running quick health check: latency OK, 4xx parsing errors spike in eu-west. Rolling back EU routing would stop customer hits.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks:
- All instances healthy: PASS
- KV cache pressure: OK
- Error rate (v2 eu): 0.9% -> alert threshold 0.2%: FAIL

sylvie: Vote: pause and pin EU to v1. We need a rollback plan and short release notes update about schema change.

jamal: Commands ready:
```
# pin eu routing to v1
redwood route set --region eu-west-1 --model v1 --force --comment "pin after schema drift 3961234567"
# shift global canary to 5% while investigating
redwood rollout update --model v2 --percent 5 --regions global
```

nora: I'll update the release notes and PR with the breaking change note. Can someone collect 10 failing examples (anonymized)?

kai: Dropping 10 examples into /s3/diagnostics/3961234567/anonymized.json

lisa: :thumbsup: on pinning. Also recommend creating an eval set and running a quick regression test across quantized variants.

ops-oncall: Executing pin now unless objections in 2m.

jamal: No objections. Proceed.

deploy-bot: Routing override applied: eu-west-1 -> v1 (pin) at 3961234578 by jamal. Canary v2 set to 5% global at 3961234580.

sylvie: Confirmed: EU error spike resolved in dashboard. We'll keep the pin until patch/re-eval. Thanks team.

lisa: Postmortem plan: triage, fix decoder, canary again with synthetic tests. I'll draft runbook.

nora: Release notes PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pulls/462

sylvie: Marking thread resolved. Moving to follow-up in #incidents for remediation work. :white_check_mark:
